name: Better Belts
author: MSML
description:
Pneumatic tubes: glass tubes sunk into the ground that shoot capsules along up to 5x as fast as conveyor belts (10x in SETTINGS).

Build them with the Pneumatic tube card (Logistics) like belts, up to 90 m in one piece. They connect to belts, splitters, mergers and machines, rising out of the ground to meet them, and you can walk and drive over them. A tube on its own runs at belt speed; put a Tube booster in the line (aim at a tube to build one into it) and the capsules after it are shot along at full speed. Boosters run on solar power like any machine (you'll see the blue power beam and hear them hiss). The pressure carries through tubes, splitters and mergers (not belts or machines) and fades after about 80 m, so put the next booster where the tube turns yellow.

The rings on the tubes show the pressure: green is full speed, yellow is fading, red is belt speed. They glow brighter while you're building. A colour-blind palette is in SETTINGS, along with the speed, range, prices and power.

Tubes never stop: losing a booster or power only slows them to belt speed. Removing a tube deletes the capsules in it. Remove the mod and tubes become plain belts again. Everyone in a crew needs the mod.
